caption:
Hook-on chair listing keeps coming back? Look at the edition in your file.
Since July 20, 2026, 16 CFR 1233.2 says each portable hook-on chair must comply with ASTM F1235-25. Before that date, it cited F1235-18.
If your test reports only point to the 2018 version, check them against the current rule before you resend anything.
Your certificate must list each applicable rule, like part 1233, separately (16 CFR 1110.11(a)(2)).

sources.quote: Each portable hook-on chair must comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F1235-25, Standard Consumer Safety Specification for Portable Hook-On Chairs, approved November 15, 2025.

Link to an amendment published at 91 FR 15540, Mar. 30, 2026. Each portable hook-on chair must comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F1235-18, Standard Consumer Safety Specification for Portable Hook-On Chairs, approved May 1, 2018.
Finished product certificates must identify separately all applicable rules, bans, standards, or regulations.
